sentences.text: In Iceland, the old tales say the shepherd blood carries a heavy curse from father to son.
Tonight, the full moon climbs the sky, and its pale light triggers the ancient change.
The young shepherd feels his bones cracking as he steps outside the lonely stone hut.
A massive, ash-colored bear rises from the snow, shaking heavy frost from its thick fur.
The village below sleeps peacefully, unaware of what now roams the frozen path.
Through the frosty window, a terrified neighbor watches the beast step closer to the door.
The heavy oak door splinters under a sudden, overwhelming blow from the creature.
Only a dropped lantern remains in the silent snow, and the shepherd is simply never seen again.
